model: Axisymmetric MWPotential2014-shape, renormalized to Gaia DR3 local circular speed
limitations: This is an extrapolated, axisymmetric GALACTIC PLANE model, not direct observed gravity in each of 729 stations.
Renormalization at 8.277 kpc and 233 km/s means model is not galpy's canonical 8 kpc, 220 km/s MWPotential2014.
Bulge, disk and NFW shares at the Sun are model-defined; do not interpret as uniquely measured matter fractions.
Black hole mass at center uses a Newtonian point source outside its horizon; r=0 is undefined.
Model is midplane with no bar, spiral arms, detailed inner Galactic Center nuclear disk, gas, individual stars or perturbations.
A circular-speed profile computed from model should not be read as observed stellar speeds near the Galactic Center.
The halo's NFW profile is extrapolated, not constrained by this single circular-speed anchor.
